description_en: Executes a specified stage of a publish flow
description_zh: 调用此接口，可以执行发布流程的指定阶段
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public exec-pipeline-run-stage --project-id 10000 --id a7ef0634-20ec-4a7c-a214-54020f91XXXX --code DEV_CHECK --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ExecPipelineRunStage

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the workspace settings page to obtain the workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the publish flow
parameters.help_zh: 发布流程的唯一标识符
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The code of the publish flow stage. For the specific value, see the response of the GetPipelineRun operation
parameters.help_zh: 表示发布流程阶段的代码，具体以GetPipelineRun接口的返回值为准
parameters.name: code

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Used for locating logs and troubleshooting issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:
true: The call is successful.
false: The call failed.
<notice>This only indicates whether the stage is triggered, not the execution result of the publish stage.></notice>
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。取值如下：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败。
<notice>只表示触发阶段执行是否成功，不代表发布阶段执行结果></notice>
